title: Certified Jamie market/loft setup never appears on FORTIFY or DRIVE
body:
Certifying Jamie’s market report / paying for the fodder-loft setup **never appears** once the player commits FORTIFY or DRIVE. Players spent 15 minutes on a loft/LURE benefit that did not show on those plans.

Grok-4.6 MCP wave: about **10** `bugs[]` rows (S1–S2) on FORTIFY/DRIVE after market testimony.

Fix: either surface the loft/market term on FORTIFY and DRIVE where it was paid for, or stop advertising a loft route on those plans after certification.

Evidence: grok-4.6 instant-thinking wave, 82 completed interviews, build `fe2619a8`.

evidence.summary: Grok-4.6 MCP wave cluster (10 mentions, 82 completed interviews).
